name: Base Dollar
oneLiner: BD is Base Dollar's live Liquity V2 fork on Base, minted against ETH, LSTs, cbETH, and cbBTC, with Stability Pool fee yield.
collateral: ETH, wstETH, rETH, cbETH, and cbBTC in separate overcollateralized Liquity V2-style borrowing branches on Base; AERO and Aerodrome LP collateral are planned but were not live at launch
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDPs with user-set interest rates, direct on-chain redemption for system collateral, and branch-specific Stability Pools that absorb liquidations and receive borrower and liquidation fees

milestones.title: Base Dollar announced as Liquity V2 fork on Base L2
milestones.description: LP-collateralized stablecoin with yield from AERO farming; revenue shared between users, POL treasury, and BD stakers.

milestones.title: External security audit remediation: high and medium severity fixes merged
milestones.description: Merged fixes for LP token price manipulation vulnerability (H01) and timelock bypass bug (M02); fuzz tests added for Aero LP pricing.

milestones.title: Post-audit remediation ongoing — oracle staleness, TWAP/slippage, and sAMM-overflow fixes merged
milestones.description: GitHub activity through May 21 2026 shows continued audit-finding remediation (oracle staleness-check, TWAP/slippage handling, and sAMM overflow fixes) merged into the main branch; no mainnet deployment yet.

milestones.title: Deployed to Base Sepolia testnet
milestones.description: Testnet deployment and subgraph merged via PR #139.

milestones.title: Production contracts deployed to Base mainnet
milestones.description: PR #160 merged with broadcast artifacts for chain 8453; BoldToken live at 0x252d36f435582ecb01686448d21e8c9ea0b2ca65 with ~2,500 BD seeded. Production frontend deployed August 3. No public launch announcement yet.

milestones.title: Base Dollar officially launches on Base
milestones.description: Public borrowing and Stability Pool deposits opened for BD, with ETH, wstETH, rETH, cbETH, and cbBTC available as launch collateral.
